_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score has moved ±2+ in only 3% of recent 12h windows — this is a textbook coil where HOLD with conviction is the statistically honest call, and neither brain provides a confirmed breaker signal.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD with medium conviction citing broken structure; narrative implies a coiled-spring bottom awaiting catalyst but does not explicitly call direction, creating a split between structural caution and pattern-based optimism
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows recover above 30 AND MVRV Z-score climbs above 30 with funding staying below 0.03%
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX breaks above 70, stablecoin growth drops below 35, or BTC funding spikes above 0.05% with price rejection at $65K signaling forced selling deeper into Panic
